ws.overviewHint: What this system is, how it works and what it can do now.
overview.claim: Fills the empty columns of an Excel table with values you can check.
overview.lead: You describe in your own words what you need. The AI proposes a plan built only from the steps listed below; you read it and approve it. Only then does the system run the plan, look the values up in open sources and write them into a copy of your table — together with where each value came from.
overview.how.table.title: Give it a table
overview.how.table.text: Upload an Excel workbook or open one of the examples.
overview.how.task.title: Say what to fill in
overview.how.task.text: Choose the columns to fill and describe the task in your own words — or ask the AI to suggest one.
overview.how.plan.title: Read the plan and approve it
overview.how.plan.text: The plan is shown step by step in plain words. Nothing runs before you approve it.
overview.how.result.title: Take the result
overview.how.result.text: Download the filled copy and the report. A name with several matches waits for your choice.
overview.canHint: A plan is built only from these steps. The list comes from the server and grows together with the system.
overview.canHintAdvanced: A plan is built only from these steps. Under each: its contract exactly as the planning model is shown it, and the source that answers for it. The list is read from /api/capabilities.
overview.computed: Calculated here, without an outside source.
overview.beginText: Begin with your own table, or see the whole path on a prepared example first.
overview.know.limit: One run fills up to {{max}} rows.
overview.know.empty: A value that cannot be confirmed is not invented: the cell stays empty and the row is offered for your decision.
overview.know.copy: Your file is not changed. The result is a copy, and a report says where each value came from.
overview.know.only: It does only what is listed here: it does not search the web freely and does not write texts.
overview.know.sends: When the AI builds a plan, your task and a sample of the table are sent to OpenAI; a run asks the listed sources about the names in the table.
overview.know.shared: This demo is one small server shared by everyone who has a code: one run at a time, and nothing is kept after a restart.
cap.geocode.title: Find the coordinates of a city
cap.geocode.text: By the city's name and its country. If several places share the name, you choose.

cap.resolve_entity.text: By the mountain's name and its country, in an open knowledge base. If several mountains match, you choose.
cap.lookup_property.title: Read the elevation of a found mountain
cap.lookup_property.text: In metres, from the record of the mountain that was found.
cap.geodesic_distance.title: Calculate the straight-line distance between two places
cap.geodesic_distance.text: The shortest way over the Earth's surface between two found places, in kilometres.
cap.ratio.title: Compare two calculated values
cap.ratio.text: How many times one is larger than the other — for example, how much longer the road is than the straight line.
cap.road_distance.title: Calculate the driving distance by road
cap.road_distance.text: The length of a car route between two found places, in kilometres. The route may include a ferry.
